publisher: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives
title_or_table: House member and committee data (MemberData.xml), committees and subcommittees with party ratios
universe_or_base: Every committee and subcommittee the Clerk lists, with the seats each party holds as the file’s ratio gives them
qualification: Ratios are seats on each committee as the Clerk’s file gives them on its publish date; vacancies and new assignments change them. The file names majority and minority, not parties: the majority is Republican in the 119th Congress, as the file’s title information says.

committee_type.description: standing, select, or other type as the file gives it

subcommittee_code.description: subcommittee code; empty on the committee’s own row

subcommittee.description: subcommittee name; empty on the committee’s own row

majority_seats.description: seats held by the majority party

minority_seats.description: seats held by the minority party

printed_source_line: Source: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives, committee and subcommittee list (MemberData.xml), 119th Congress, file of November 3, 2026. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Seat ratios as the file gives them that day.
